title: Skimmer Pricing 2026: Per-Pool Cost, Plans & Add-Ons
description: Skimmer pool software costs $1 or $2 per serviced location a month (from $49 or $98/mo). Plans, add-on prices and cost by pool count, checked Oct 30, 2026.
h1: Skimmer pricing: what you pay per pool
body:
Skimmer is pool service software that bills per serviced location (a service address), not per user. Every number below comes from Skimmer's pricing page, checked 2026-10-30. Anything Skimmer doesn't publish is marked unknown.

Skimmer plans and prices (2026)

PlanPriceMinimumBuilt for
Getting Started$1.00 per serviced location/moStarts at $49/mo (includes 49 locations)0-49 pools/month
Scaling Up$2.00 per serviced location/moStarts at $98/mo (includes 49 locations)50-1,000 pools/month
EnterpriseCustomCustom1,000+ pools/month

Annual billing prices: unknown (not published). Both main plans include unlimited technicians and admins, unlimited customers and unlimited visits per location.

How the per-location billing works

  • You pay once per month per serviced location, however many times you visit and however many bodies of water (pools, spas, fountains) are at that address.
  • Locations you don't service in a month aren't billed.
  • A serviced location is any address where you do service or repairs.

Skimmer cost by pool count (list prices)

  • 30 pools: Getting Started $49/mo (minimum); Scaling Up $98/mo (minimum).
  • 80 pools: Getting Started $80/mo; Scaling Up $160/mo.
  • 150 pools: Getting Started $150/mo; Scaling Up $300/mo.
  • 300 pools: Getting Started $300/mo; Scaling Up $600/mo.

Skimmer's own description of Getting Started is 0-49 pools, so it's built for smaller routes; the arithmetic above just applies the published per-location rate.

What Scaling Up adds

Quotes and estimates, job management, the Schedule, recurring work orders, route optimization, the LSI and dosing calculator powered by Orenda, LaMotte integration, unlimited service texts, consumer financing through Sunbit, productivity reporting, required checklist items, broadcast emails, live phone support and more photos per visit (20 vs 5).

Add-ons and fees

  • Service texts on Getting Started: $0.029 per message (included unlimited on Scaling Up).
  • AI Phone: $99/mo. Marketing Suite: $150/mo. Bookkeeping: from $198/mo.
  • Card processing rates: unknown (not on the pricing page; the page lists online payments and surcharging).

Free trial and guarantee

On 2026-10-30 Skimmer offered new users one month of Scaling Up free (up to 49 locations; usage beyond 49 is billed in arrears after the trial unless cancelled; after the trial, $98/mo base + $2 per additional location). It also lists a 30-day refund guarantee. Skimmer says it can change or end the promotion.

How Skimmer's price compares

  • Pool Brain: $50/mo base + $65/mo per active field tech. See Pool Brain.
  • Pool Office Manager: $125/mo first user + $25/mo per extra user, no per-customer charges. See Pool Office Manager.
  • GorillaDesk: from $49/mo per route with unlimited users. See GorillaDesk.

Rule of thumb from list prices: Skimmer gets pricier as your pool count grows; per-tech tools get pricier as you hire. Compare scheduling features in pool service scheduling software and the full field in best pool service software.

faq: Skimmer's pricing page lists Getting Started at $1 per serviced location per month (starts at $49/mo) and Scaling Up at $2 per serviced location per month (starts at $98/mo). Enterprise (1,000+ pools) is custom pricing. Checked 2026-10-30.
No. Both main plans include unlimited technicians and admins; billing is per serviced location.
Am I charged every time I visit a pool?
No. Skimmer bills once per month per serviced location regardless of visit count, and doesn't bill locations you didn't service that month.
Does Skimmer have a free trial?
As of 2026-10-30, Skimmer offers new users the first month of Scaling Up free (up to 49 locations) and a 30-day refund guarantee.
Route Optimization is listed on Scaling Up. Getting Started includes Route Builder.
